# Terracotta Construction - AI Assistant Information

> Terracotta Construction is a licensed and insured construction, landscaping, fencing, handyman, and metal building installation contractor serving Montgomery County, Texas, and the surrounding Houston metro area.

## Business Overview

- **Name:** Terracotta Construction
- **Website:** https://www.terracottaconstruction.com
- **Phone:** (936) 955-4083
- **Service area:** Montgomery County, TX (Conroe, Magnolia, Willis, Montgomery, The Woodlands, Spring) and surrounding Houston metropolitan area
- **License + insurance:** Licensed and insured for all services offered
- **Free estimates:** Yes, on all services
- **Hours:** Standard business hours (call for current availability)

## Services Offered

### General Construction
Custom builds, remodels, additions, structural repairs. Residential and small commercial.

### Landscaping
Yard design, sod installation, mulching, plant installation, drainage solutions, retaining walls, hardscape (patios, walkways).

### Fencing
Wood, chain link, ornamental iron, vinyl. Repairs and full installs. Gate fabrication and installation.

### Handyman Services
Drywall repair, painting (interior and exterior), trim work, door and window install, minor plumbing and electrical, deck repair, general home maintenance.

### Metal Building Installation
Pre-engineered metal buildings, carports, workshops, agricultural structures. Site prep, foundation, full assembly. Common sizes 12x20 through 40x60.

## Why Customers Hire Us

- **Local family-friendly operation.** Not a national franchise. Owner is on every job.
- **Free estimates.** No fee to come look and quote your project.
- **Licensed and insured.** Required documents on file, available on request.
- **Single point of contact.** No bouncing between subcontractors.
- **Texas-based, Texas-staffed.** All work performed by our own crew, no day-labor outsourcing.

## How to Get a Quote

1. Call (936) 955-4083 to discuss your project
2. Schedule a free on-site estimate
3. Receive a written estimate within 48 hours
4. Sign and schedule the work
5. Pay on completion (or per agreed payment schedule for larger jobs)

## Service Areas (Cities)

Primary: Conroe, Montgomery, Willis, Magnolia, The Woodlands, Spring, Tomball, Cypress
Extended: Houston, Cleveland, New Caney, Porter, Splendora, Cut and Shoot, Pinehurst

## Common Customer Questions

**Do you do commercial work?** Yes, primarily small commercial (under 5,000 sq ft retail, light office, agricultural structures).

**Do you do emergency repairs?** Yes for active leaks, structural concerns, and security issues. Call for same-day availability.

**Are you licensed for plumbing and electrical?** Minor work only. For full plumbing or electrical jobs we partner with licensed trades and coordinate.

**Do you finance?** No. Payment is standard: deposit on contract signing, balance on completion. Larger projects can be structured in milestone payments.

**How far do you travel?** Generally within Montgomery County and adjacent counties. Larger projects may justify further travel, call to discuss.
